pageContent: # General Company Information

PT Bumi Nirwana Estate, along with its legal project entity PT. Margojoyo Anugrah Persada, is a property developer focused on providing quality housing in Lumajang. Our vision is to help the community, especially millennials and new families, own their dream home by offering properties that are high-quality, comfortable, strategic, and affordable. Our projects are located in key areas such as Klampokarum (Tekung), Sumberejo (Sukodono), and the city center in Ditotrunana. Our marketing office is located at
Ditotrunana. Our marketing office is located at Jalan Achmad Yani No. 172, Lumajang.

# Property Project Details

## The Margojoyo Residence

The Margojoyo Residence is strategically located in Desa Klampokarum, Tekung, Lumajang. Its prime position is on the main road (Nol Jalan Raya) and it is only 5 minutes from the Lumajang town square (Alun-Alun). This project offers two property types. First, a Subsidized House (Rumah Subsidi) type 30/72 priced at Rp 166,000,000. The down payment (DP) is only 1%, which is Rp 1,660,000, with a booking fee (Uang Tanda Jadi) of Rp 1,000,000. The mortgage (KPR) installment simulations are: Rp 1,700,000/month

installment simulations are: Rp 1,700,000/month for a 10-year tenor, Rp 1,299,000/month for 15 years, and Rp 1,070,000/month for 20 years. The house specifications include 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a carport, kitchen, garden space, 900 Watt electricity, and a drilled well for water. Active promotions for this type include Free AJB/BBN and Free BPHTB. Second, a 2-story Shop House (Ruko) type 80/60 is available for Rp 250,000,000. Public facilities at The Margojoyo Residence include a Musholla (prayer room)
Residence include a Musholla (prayer room) and paved roads with a width of 6-7 meters.
## Bumi Nirwana Sumberejo

Bumi Nirwana Sumberejo is located in Desa Sumberejo, Sukodono, Lumajang, offering a strategic location close to the city center. This housing project is specifically aimed at millennials and those with minimum wage (UMR) salaries who wish to own their first home. The house type is 30/60, priced at Rp 166,000,000 with light installments starting from 1 million per month. The most attractive promotion for this project is the Zero DP (Tanpa DP) offer, along with Free All Fees (Free Semua Biaya). The
along with Free All Fees (Free Semua Biaya). The specifications for this single-story house include 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a carport, and a multipurpose room.

## The Royal Avenue
The Royal Avenue is a premium commercial housing project located in the heart of Lumajang city at Jl. Demokrasi, Ditotrunana. It features luxurious 2-story homes with a modern and elegant design. A unit is priced at Rp 300,000,000 with a special "Free All Fees" promotion. The facilities in each unit are extensive, including 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a 1-car garage, a kitchen, 3 living rooms, and most notably, a private swimming pool.

# KPR Process and Requirements Information

The Booking Fee (Uang Tanda Jadi or UTJ) to secure a unit is around Rp 750,000 to Rp 1,000,000 for subsidized houses and is non-refundable in case of unilateral cancellation. However, the Down Payment (DP) is refundable if the KPR application is rejected due to a failed BI Checking. The selling price of the house includes the IMB/PBG (building permits), electricity installation, and a drilled well. General requirements for a KPR application include photocopies of KTP, KK, NPWP, passport-sized photos,

of KTP, KK, NPWP, passport-sized photos, marriage certificate, the last 3 months of salary slips, and a letter of employment. For civil servants (PNS), the latest SK document is required. For entrepreneurs, SIUP/TDP or SKU documents are needed.
# Answers for Various Customer Situations

For those who are tired of renting and moving every year, owning a home provides invaluable peace and stability. We offer subsidized housing with monthly installments that are often lighter than rent. For those facing financial constraints, such as having a minimum wage salary or difficulty saving for a down payment, the Bumi Nirwana Sumberejo project with its Zero DP promotion is a golden opportunity. Buying a house is a crucial investment before prices increase further. For families looking to upgrade

increase further. For families looking to upgrade their quality of life, The Royal Avenue with its luxurious facilities is the perfect choice. If you are worried that the KPR process is complicated, our team is ready to assist you every step of the way, from the beginning until the key handover. To schedule a site visit, you can contact our marketing team.
